title: A computational investigation of galactopyranoside esters as antimicrobial agents through antiviral, molecular docking, molecular dynamics, pharmacokinetics, and bioactivity prediction.
authors: Hosen, Mohammed A; El Bakri, Youness; Rehman, Hafiz Muzzammel; Hashem, Heba E; Saki, Morteza; Kawsar, Sarkar M A
one_liner_zh: 该文对半乳糖苷酯进行DFT、分子对接和MD模拟，评估其与HPV E2 DNA结合域等蛋白的结合稳定性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA核心体系，方法可迁移。
abstract: One of the most common viral infections worldwide is the Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) which has been linked to cancer and other diseases in many countries. Monosaccharide esters are significant in the field of carbohydrate chemistry because they are efficient in the synthesis of pharmacologically active compounds. Therefore, the present study aimed to perform thermodynamic, molecular docking and molecular dynamics study of a series of previously designed monosaccharaides, methyl beta-d-galactopyranoside (MGP, 1) esters (2-10) with along with their physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties. We have optimized the MGP esters employing the DFT study at the B3LYP/6-311 + G (d,p) level of theory. The subsequent analysis also investigated the electronic energies, enthalpies, entropies, polarizability, and natural bond orbital (NBO) of these modified esters. Then, MGP esters were docked into CTX-M-15 extended-spectrum beta-lactamase from Escherichia coli (PDB: 4HBT) and E2 DNA-binding domain from human papillomavirus type 31 (PDB: 1A7G), and the results revealed that most of the esters can efficiently bind to the target. Desmond was used to doing molecular dynamics simulations at 200 ns in addition to molecular docking to look at the binding conformational stability of the protein-ligand complex. Based on RMSD and RMSF, it was determined that the stability of the protein-ligand combination was maintained during the whole 200 ns simulations for all compounds. Finally, a pharmacokinetic study suggests that modified esters of MGP exhibited better pharmacokinetic characteristics and were less hazardous than the parent drug. This work demonstrated that potential MGP esters can efficiently bind to 4HBT and 1A7G proteins and opened avenues for the development of newer antimicrobial agents that can target dangerous pathogens.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 全球最常见的病毒感染之一是人乳头瘤病毒（HPV），该病毒在许多国家已被证实与癌症及其他疾病相关。单糖酯在碳水化合物化学领域具有重要意义，因为它们在合成药理活性化合物方面效率高。因此，本研究旨在对一系列先前设计的单糖——甲基β-D-吡喃半乳糖苷（MGP, 1）酯类（2-10）进行热力学、分子对接和分子动力学研究，并评估其理化及药代动力学性质。我们采用DFT方法在B3LYP/6-311 + G (d,p)理论水平上优化了MGP酯类。后续分析还考察了这些修饰酯的电子能量、焓、熵、极化率和自然键轨道（NBO）。随后，将MGP酯类对接至来自大肠杆菌的CTX-M-15超广谱β-内酰胺酶（PDB: 4HBT）和来自人乳头瘤病毒31型的E2 DNA结合域（PDB: 1A7G），结果显示大多数酯能有效结合靶标。除分子对接外，使用Desmond进行了200 ns的分子动力学模拟，以考察蛋白质-配体复合物的结合构象稳定性。基于RMSD和RMSF，确定所有化合物在200 ns模拟期间蛋白质-配体组合的稳定性得以维持。最后，药代动力学研究表明，MGP的修饰酯表现出更好的药代动力学特性，且比母体药物危害更小。本研究证明，潜在的MGP酯能有效结合4HBT和1A7G蛋白，为开发针对危险病原体的新型抗菌剂开辟了途径。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
